name: FlutterFlow
category: App builder (Flutter) with an AI agent

pricing.free_plan: Free: 0 $, a free AI allowance and 2 projects in Studio; a public web build is not part of the free plan

tiers.name: Free
tiers.note: free AI allowance, 2 projects, no published web app

capabilities: AI agent builds a multi-screen app from one prompt
Free plan can deploy to the web on up to two subdomains
Generated app included a booking form, a confirmation screen and an admin page
limits: App stores and a public web build need a paid plan
The free plan stops at 2 projects and a fixed AI allowance
The app runs in FlutterFlow's sandbox until it is published

not_testable.reason: Launching the app on the web is not part of the free plan (confirmed in the account on 17.11.2026), and the app stores are paid as well. The sandbox run proves the booking app works — 2 of 12 criteria — but without a public URL there is nothing to measure.
